dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: Oh yeah I meant to ask, have you guys figured out any information on how to track down my parents and put a stop to this?

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: We came close to dying to your dumbass parents the other day. We barely had the chance to get away alive. But I did manage to come up with an idea on how to get a lead.

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: Yeah man, my booty was clenched. I thought we were gonna die for sure, hahah!

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: It’s clear we’re not safe to be out in the public for long, they will be eying us down. They know who we are.

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: I wish I can go out and help you guys but I know if I leave this area, I’m done for. Although, I think I have an idea as to where you guys can go to like... get some info on my parents and stuff.

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: You don’t say. What might that be, huh?

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: Okay so likeeee... my parents loooove laundering. Sometimes I catch them devising their little plans with each other but they do it so secretly, I don’t even get the full details.

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: Buuuut, I do know they like to do car meetups and like to host their lil’ business schemes there.

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: But I thought your parents were rockstars? Don't they get money from that, right? Why the hell do they need to do this mumbo jumbo... hip hoppity, riggamorole stuff?

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: Heh, you would think so right? We are rich, I will admit that, but the majority of their earnings comes from... Well, let’s just say 'not good ways'.

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: Interesting, the rabbit hole runs deeper than I thought. I do know a few meetups that happen across the city. In fact, I know one that is scheduled to happen tonight near a OneShot parking lot.

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: We keep tabs on these meets for anything shady going down, 9 times out of 10, some shit goes down. I usually don’t go out there to investigate myself, but now I have a proper reason to see it for myself.

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: Well that's kewlll... one question though, who’s going and what needs to be done?

dialogue.name: Boyfriend & Nova
dialogue.text: *gleaming*

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: No no no, not you two yet. You two are a higher target than Jasmine and I. So we’ll go.

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: AGAIN?? ARE YOU CRAZY?

dialogue.name: Jasmine
dialogue.text: Wait wait... if we dress up and change how we look enough, maybe... just maybe it won’t be as dangerous.

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: Exactlyyyy! Then you guys go in, cause a lot of drama and get the attention of the higher ups there. There’s usually one supervisor that controls the entire function.

dialogue.name: Girlfriend
dialogue.text: Do well enough and they might recruit you and BAM! You’re in the system! If you’re one of them, I guess they won’t suspect a thing, haha! They're kinda like... dumb.

dialogue.name: Lucy
dialogue.text: All of this sounds so damn stupid, it might just work. C’mon jazzy, we got some bitchin' to do.
